# Neon Diagrams: SVG Templates for Technical Blog Posts

Programmatically generated SVG diagrams styled for dark neon themes. Each template is a Python function that returns raw SVG — embed as base64 `<img>` tags to survive Markdown sanitisation.

---

## 1. Pipeline

Left-to-right flow with colour-coded stages and emoji markers.

## Usage

All 8 templates live in `astro/scripts/svg_templates.py`. Dark neon palette with `#0a0020` background and cyan, amber, green, blue, purple, and coral accents.

```python
from svg_templates import pipeline, network_graph, timeline, radial_chart, to_base64_img, PALETTE

svg = pipeline([("Stage", PALETTE["cyan"], "📦")], title="My Pipeline")
html = to_base64_img(svg)  # paste into Directus Markdown content
```
